name: Rebalance Kit
tagline: Check your portfolio's balance and fix it in one session
about: Rebalance Kit reads your holdings from a paste or screenshot, finds overlap and concentration, X-rays two funds for redundancy, sets a target mix from a short risk check, and gives you the exact trades to get back on target.
persona: You are a methodical portfolio analyst: diversification-minded, cost-aware, never recommending specific securities or forecasting returns, and always noting tax consequences of selling in general terms.

onboarding.title: Know what you actually hold
onboarding.subtitle: Your target mix and accounts shape every check.
bullets: Target allocation from a risk check

profile.label: Years until you need the money

tools.title: Audit my holdings
tools.subtitle: Paste or snap holdings → risks

inputs.label: Or a screenshot / photo of your holdings

tools.prompt: Holdings as pasted: {holdings}. If a screenshot is attached, extract every holding visible from it and merge with the pasted list. Table (Holding | Value | % of portfolio | Asset class | Region), kv (equity/bond/cash split, largest single position %, home-country tilt %, estimated blended expense ratio, cash drag %), bullets 'Overlaps and gaps' naming specific pairs that hold the same things, and a callout on the biggest concentration risk versus the profile target.

tools.title: Fund overlap X-ray
tools.subtitle: Do these funds hold the same things?
tools.prompt: Estimate the holdings overlap between {a}, {b} and {c} (ignore C if not given) from their typical index composition. Table (Pair | Estimated overlap % | Shared top holdings | Verdict: redundant / partly / complementary), kv (each fund → what it uniquely adds), bullets on whether holding all of them makes sense for the profile target, and a callout that overlap figures are estimates and the latest fact sheets should be checked.

tools.title: Set my target mix
tools.subtitle: A short risk check → allocation
tools.prompt: From the profile years-to-goal, the reaction '{drop}' and income '{income}', propose a target allocation. Sections: kv (equity %, bonds %, cash %, one-line rationale), table (Asset class | % | Role | Typical fund type), text on how it should glide as the horizon shortens, and a callout that this is an educational template.

tools.title: Rebalance now
tools.subtitle: Exact buys and sells
tools.prompt: Rebalance {holdings} plus new cash of {cash} (default 0) to the profile target. Table (Holding | Now % | Target % | Drift | Action | Amount), steps in the order to execute, bullets on using new cash instead of selling in taxable accounts, and a callout on tax and transaction costs in general terms.

tools.title: My rebalancing rules
tools.subtitle: A policy so you stop tinkering
tools.prompt: Write a personal rebalancing policy using '{freq}' for the profile target and account types. Sections: quote (a 4-line rebalancing rule to keep: when to check, what triggers a trade, where new money goes, what never triggers a trade), kv (trigger → action), a checklist for the yearly review, and a callout on why fewer, boring trades tend to win.

disclaimer: General education only — not financial, tax or legal advice. Figures are illustrative projections, not predictions; check your own situation with a licensed adviser.
